title: MV weather effect only in specific region

posts.author: white90
posts.body:
Hello, i'm making a illustrator point & click game. the rain effect base of rpg maker already perfectly matches the graphic style, but I would need to make it appear only on the windows of a house, interior. I know that many will say to create parallax images, with more frames but reproduce at least 4 frames, to resemble the program’s rain effect is a disaster. I’ve already seen that for rpg maker vx ace, someone in 5 seconds to created a mini script working very well
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/regional-wheater-effects.88381/
If someone can help me, I would be truly grateful, and it would make my life much easier. Thanks!

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
there might be some ways, depends on the size of the window.
you can do rain behind the window (to stepping animation and without
when not raining).
so you need windows character sheet (loop through 4 images
(up, left,right,down) and repeat, but if you want it through regions only,
this will always be in front of the window, not behind.
behind window require parallax with layer options, so I don't know if there
is a cleaner way.
outside with region would be better, but inside, it might be harder, so the best
approach is probably eventing on a char-sheet?
